input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: §12.4 imposes a one-way restrictive covenant on us alone: it covers all Vendor employees (not just personnel involved in the Services), runs 24 months post-term, and extends to hiring or employing "regardless of how the employee applies" — i.e. a true no-hire with no general-advertising or unsolicited-applicant carve-out. That sits at the playbook walk-away line and also contradicts §12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment. Preferred position is no non-solicit on us, so we delete §12.4; the fallback (mutual, involved personnel only, 12 months, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs) is offered in the comment.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the one-way non-solicit/no-hire in 12.4: our position is that no non-solicitation restriction binds us, and a 24-month bar on hiring any Vendor employee "regardless of how the employee applies" is a no-hire that directly contradicts 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment. If you need some protection, we can accept a mutual clause limited to direct solicitation of personnel involved in the Services for 12 months, with carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches.
proposal.summary: Delete one-way 24-month non-solicit/no-hire on Customer (§12.4), which conflicts with §12.3.
